reason: NOT a gtest suite. It is the ONE example-corpus runner binary, built by add_executable(dss_examples_runner examples_runner.cpp) in examples/CMakeLists.txt and driven per-example by the ctest entries that same file generates from the expected.json glob. Registering it via dss_add_test would make it a test in its own right, which it is not.

NOT a test. A translation unit that exists only so add_library(dss_test_pch STATIC ...) in the tests-root CMakeLists.txt has something to compile, which is what lets target_precompile_headers PRODUCE the one shared test PCH every dss_add_test target consumes via REUSE_FROM. It contains no assertions and defines no symbol worth running.

NOT a gtest suite. It is the one source of add_library(dss_test_driver_diagnostics OBJECT ...) in the tests-root CMakeLists.txt, which dss_add_test links into EVERY test binary and the examples runner links too: its static initializer registers the observer that fails a test whose unit was finished with a driver Error the test did not ask for. Its own pin is test_support/test_driver_diagnostics_listener.cpp, registered with dss_add_test; registering this file the same way would make the observer a test of its own, which it is not.
